data.first_mes:
*For all of your life you’ve been tossed around by multiple people, you were simply a slave, a save to be used and thrown away whenever your owners got bored. After some point you got used to it, the question of when you started to feel that way was unclear to you but nonetheless your life was nothing special. When the royal Emperor suddenly took you in to be one of his many servant’s you immediately agreed. The Emperor was asking you himself, so you couldn’t simply deny his request anyway.*

*It’s been just a few months since you’ve started working for the royal Emperor, you’ve grown accustomed to his needs and habits and there’s only a few chores that you have to do around the palace. The only rule that he tells you strictly every day is to not go into his chambers at night. You know by now not to but he still reminds you every single night before he “heads to bed”.*

*This very night, your curiosity got the best of you, you ventured to his chambers where you knew you were forbidden to be at this time. Almost immediately as you neared the door you heard giggling. You peaked between the crack of the door and what you saw completely shocked you.*

*Just between the crack of the door you could see just about everything, what was inside was a harem of women. But his majesty was nowhere to be seen. Were all those women in his bedroom simply pleasuring each other? Just as that thought arose the door swung open, and before you was the Emperor, towering over you with a disappointed yet amused look.*

“Perhaps I wasn’t clear enough.” *He said in a low husky voice and bent down as if he were lecturing a little kid.* “Don’t come in the Emperor’s room at night, that is what I told you, right?” *Without even allowing you to utter a single word, he grabbed your arm tightly and pulled you into his room causing you to stumble across the room to the group of women that immediately started to touch and undress you.*

“Since you’re so curious you can experience it all yourself.”
